name: holder
title: Pen holder with lift
orientation: Flat on the bed: the drawing's x and y are the bed's, the pen's axis along y. The leaves bend within their layers. PETG: it creeps less than PLA held bent
description: A shuttle holding the pen on two tapered leaves: a parallel guide. Its spring is the pen's pressure; an SG90 on a stock horn lifts it. Drawn at rest, the leaves straight.

thick.rule: The block's thickness, 80 layers, and the leaves' width

pen_x.rule: From the bolts to the pen

paper.rule: The paper, in this frame: the bench is the sheet's plane, the bolts are level with the forearm's middle

pen_d.rule: A 10 mm fineliner, 0.2 mm each side; set this to your pen

pen_wall.rule: The shuttle reaches this far past the pen each way

leaf_t.rule: Two lines: stiff enough against pen drag, soft enough for the servo

leaf_l.rule: Long enough to keep the strain small at full lift
leaf_l.label: Leaf

taper.rule: Thickened toward both ends: the strain spread along the leaf

fillet.rule: A round where each leaf meets its block: no square corner to yield at

travel.rule: 1 mm below the paper at rest, to 4 mm above it lifted

gap.rule: Between the leaves: resists the pen's drag twisting the shuttle

block_x.rule: Half the bolt block's length along x

shuttle.rule: Half the shuttle's height along y

bolt_y.rule: Half the bolts' spacing along x

clamp.rule: The pen's clamp screw, self-tapped through the shuttle's wall

lug_x0.rule: The lug the horn lifts, its left edge

lug_x1.rule: Its right edge, clear of the pen

lug_y.rule: Its underside, a hair above the horn at rest

horn_at.rule: Horn seat above the tabs: the case's top and boss

lug_wide.rule: The lug's depth along y where it stands up: strong enough for 3 N

frame_top.rule: The frame's top edge, clear of the lower leaf's travel
